title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Torterra Wild Force 005/071 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon TCG card features the powerful Torterra EX from the Wild Force set. With a Stage 2 evolution, this card boasts an impressive 340 HP and a unique set of attacks, including Forest March and Jungle Hammer. The card is a Double Rare with a holographic finish, making it a valuable addition to any collection.

Manufactured by Nintendo in Japan, this card is made from high-quality card stock and features stunning artwork by illustrator PLANETA Tsuji. The card number is 005/071, and it is a Standard size card with a Grass attribute. Perfect for collectors and players alike, this card is sure to be a valuable addition to any Pokémon TCG collection.
